services.summary: The tool registry: a plugin adds model-callable tools. The Engine owns calling, approval and results.
services.availabilityText: Available to every plugin that injects it.

methods.name: register
methods.summary: Register one tool built with defineTool from @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools. The definition must stay inside the supported JSON Schema subset (type, oneOf, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, const). A second argument is refused. Returns an idempotent disposer.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(name: string, agent: Agent): { name: string } | undefined
methods.summary: Whether the calling agent has a tool by this name. Answers only inside a live tool call, for that call's own agent.

services.summary: Slash commands a person types. A handler runs only when the person types the command.
services.availabilityText: Available to every plugin that injects it.

methods.name: register
methods.signature: register(definition: { name: string, description: string, argumentHint?: string, handler(call: { args: string, signal: AbortSignal }): CommandResult }): () => void
methods.summary: Register one slash command. Names start with a lower case letter, then lower case letters, digits, _ and -, at most 64 characters; at most 64 commands per plugin. A name that clashes with a built-in command gets the alias plugin-<plugin-slug>-<command>, and is refused if that alias is invalid or also taken. A name another plugin already registered is refused, so pick a plugin-specific name. Returns an idempotent disposer.

services.summary: Owner-local JSON persistence under the data folder the Engine assigned. It holds no session history and no secrets.
services.availabilityText: Available to every plugin that injects it.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Read one stored value.

methods.name: set
methods.summary: Store one JSON value, within the bounded key, value and owner limits.

methods.name: delete
methods.summary: Remove one stored value.

services.summary: Skill roots: reviewed folders of skills added to the Engine's skill catalog.
services.availabilityText: Available to every plugin that injects it.

methods.name: registerRoot
methods.summary: Add a bundle-relative folder of SKILL.md packages. At most 8 roots per plugin. Absolute paths, links, empty components, . and .. are refused.

services.summary: The session of the calling tool invocation.
services.availabilityText: Answers only inside a live tool call of the plugin.

methods.name: flush
methods.summary: Ask the Engine to persist the committed prefix of the exact session of this tool call. Nothing else on sessions is available.

services.summary: Questions put to the person through the Engine's own question card.
services.availabilityText: Answers only inside a live tool call of the plugin.

methods.name: ask
methods.signature: ask(request: { agent: Agent, questions: Question[], signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<Answers>
methods.summary: Ask the person typed questions during a live root tool call. Timed or continued questions (wait) are not supported.

services.summary: One independent child agent a root tool call may start.
services.availabilityText: Answers only inside a live tool call of the plugin.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.summary: Describe the one provider: a fresh child with no inherited conversation.

methods.name: startActivation
methods.signature: startActivation(options: { provider: 'spawn', childId: string, request: { parent: Agent, prompt: TextBlock[], agentOptions?: { model?: string } }, signal?: AbortSignal, delivery?: 'caller' | 'parent' }): Promise<{ childId: string, messageId: string, result: Promise<ChildResult>, dispose(): Promise<void> }>
methods.summary: Start the child through the Engine's approval gate. Resolves to the activation handle { childId, messageId, result, dispose }. Prompts are text only; only the model option is accepted. Needs the live calling agent as parent and is not available inside a child.

methods.name: result
methods.signature: activation.result: Promise<{ stopReason: string, output: { type: 'text', text: string }[], diagnostic?: string }>
methods.summary: A getter, not a method: read the property, do not call it. Resolves when the child finishes, with its stop reason and its text output blocks; diagnostic notes dropped non-text blocks.

methods.name: dispose
methods.summary: Stop that exact child and its own descendants.

services.summary: Reserved. The host offers no methods on agents.
The child agent's persona slot, reachable only inside an agent/created listener.
services.availabilityText: Answers only inside an agent/created listener, on the child agent.

methods.name: section
methods.signature: agent.ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'deployment:persona-prefix', order: agent.ctx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder('DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX'), text: string }): () => void
methods.summary: Set the child's persona text, at most 32 KiB, once. name must be the string deployment:persona-prefix (the PERSONA_PREFIX_SECTION value) and order must be what getSectionOrder('DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX') returns, which is 0. Anything else is refused. Called anywhere else it fails. The Engine's own system prompt cannot be replaced.

services.summary: Cordis logging. Every line becomes a host log notification attributed to the plugin.

methods.name: logger
methods.summary: A named logger with debug, info, warn and error. The host reports error and warn as such and everything else as info.

events.name: tools/pre-execute
events.mode: ordered listeners, native hooks first, then plugin listeners in registration order
events.signature: ctx.on('tools/pre-execute', async (exec: { name: string, callId: string, arguments: object, signal: AbortSignal, workspace: string, mode: string, model: string }, next: () => Promise<Abstention>) => Verdict | undefined)
events.summary: Programmable tool admission for a reviewed native plugin. The frozen call view has no session, agent, tool or approval handle. Return { kind: 'deny', reason }, { kind: 'ask', reason? }, { kind: 'revise', input }, { kind: 'annotate', text } or { kind: 'abstain' }; undefined abstains. A malformed answer, error or timeout fails the call closed. The listener batch has a five second deadline.

events.name: agent/created
events.mode: listeners of the owning plugin only
events.signature: ctx.on('agent/created', async ({ agent }: { agent: { id: string, ctx: { systemPrompt: { getSectionOrder(name), section(section) }, tools: { restrict(filter: { deny: string[] }) } } } }) => void)
events.summary: Fires for a child agent that this plugin's own subagents.startActivation creates, before the child starts. The listener may set the child's persona and deny tools to it; the window closes when the listeners return.

config.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
config.summary: An MCP server row. The Engine proposes the server and owns the connection.
limits: stdio rows name a command; streamable-http and sse rows name a url.
Reconnect and instruction bounds belong to the Engine and are not configurable here.

command.description: stdio only: the program to run.

env.description: Must be empty or absent: credentials stay with the Engine.

cwd.description: stdio only: a bundle-relative directory, no .. components.

url.description: streamable-http and sse: the endpoint, with no credentials, query or fragment.

headers.description: Must be empty or absent: credentials stay with the Engine.

failOnStartupError.description: Only false: the Engine connects lazily and reports failures through /mcp.

config.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem
config.summary: A skill folder row, limited to reviewed roots inside the bundle.
limits: Both includeDefaultRoots and watch must be written out as false.

includeDefaultRoots.description: Must be false: ambient roots are not read.

watch.description: Must be false: there is no file watcher.

config.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code
config.summary: Claude Code style command hooks read from a reviewed file in the bundle.
limits: projectDir is refused: each process uses the current workspace.

configPath.description: A regular file inside the bundle, at most 1 MiB, unchanged since review.

pluginRoot.description: Absent, ".", or this reviewed bundle root.

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Whole seconds, used when a hook sets none; default 600000.

pluginRoot.description: Absent, ".", or this reviewed bundle root.

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Whole seconds, used when a hook sets none; default 600000.

includeRuntimeContext.description: Suppressing the runtime context belongs to the Engine.

theme.scheme: The frame sets data-theme and color-scheme on its document to the app's current scheme and follows changes.

api.name: ctx.theme.overrideTokens
api.signature: overrideTokens(source: string, tokens: Record<string, { light: string, dark: string }>): () => void
api.summary: Set custom properties on the frame's document for each scheme. source is at most 256 characters; each name starts with -- and is at most 128 characters; each value is at most 512 characters. Returns a disposer.

notes: The frame defines no named design tokens of its own. There are no --dsw-* tokens to read: a plugin that wants tokens defines them with overrideTokens and uses them in its own styles.
The frame's background is transparent and its margin is zero, so the plugin sits on the app's own surface.
